description: Publish Markdown as a beautifully typeset page and receive its https://lucid.page/<slug> URL. Works anonymously; with an lp_ API key the page is owned by the account and can be updated later. Anonymous publishes return a one-time claim_token — hand your human the claim link https://lucid.page/claim?slug=<slug>&token=<claim_token> so they can claim the page into their account (agents: POST /api/docs/<slug>/claim).

markdown.description: The Markdown source to publish (max 1 MB).

ttl.description: Lifetime in seconds (min 60). Omit for a page that never expires.

visibility.description: Defaults to unlisted. Private requires an lp_ API key.

name: publish_doc

claim_token.description: One-time ownership token (anonymous publishes only). A human claims the page at https://lucid.page/claim?slug=<slug>&token=<claim_token>; agents claim with POST /api/docs/<slug>/claim.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp, or null when the page never expires

title: Publish a Markdown document
